prompt: A low passage cut through rock, seen in a first-person view at standing eye height, its floor laid with rounded cobblestones and a rough rock ceiling close above. On the right, the low cobbled passage runs on out of the picture, and a patch of pale grey light shows at its far end. On the left, the low cobbled passage runs on out of the picture, and its far stretch is banked with mud and broken rock. The cobbles in the near foreground are bare and worn smooth. Pale grey light from the east end falls along the passage, lighting the cobbles and the rough rock walls. The picture fills the whole frame, edge to edge. Setting: a medieval fantasy world; everything is old and handmade: weathered stone and old brick, rough timber, wrought iron. Style: 1970s comic book art: bold black ink outlines, hand-inked hatching, flat printed colours with visible halftone dots, slightly off-register colour printing, muted earthy palette of browns, ochres, olive and amber, on aged newsprint. Mood: quiet, still and mysterious, a place long left alone.
